environment_caveats: Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores typically run 10-20 performance points lower and are NOT represented here.
Client record status is 'onboarding', not 'active'. Audited anyway because build_status=pushed_main and the apex responds 200. Confirm the status field is correct.
Client record has no apex_cutover.completed_at field; apex origin was selected from cut_over_at (2026-08-09) plus a live 200 response with no noindex header.
5 DataForSEO instant_pages checks were confirmed false-positive against the live HTML and excluded from verdicts. See excluded_false_positives per URL.
